# `factory/server/settings.py`

[As built](../../../README.md) › [Console screens and styling](../../../subsystems/console-screens-and-styling.md) › `settings.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Exposes HTTP endpoints for managing provider credentials, agent configuration (roles), routing, resource usage tracking, and network egress settings. Handles reading and writing all settings to config files.
